(2) The camera cuts to a medium-long shot of an outdoor street in Kaohsiung where several people are waiting in line at a roadside food stall under a red awning. Several scooters are parked along the curb. The setting is an urban street with multi-story buildings and a clear sky. (3) A sequence of close-up shots shows various posters and handwritten signs on the stall's glass partitions and walls. (5) In the final phase, the camera captures the vendor handing a bag of food to a female customer in a red shirt. The scene ends with a graphic overlay displaying the stall's address and the logo of the content creators, followed by a shot of two women standing by the stall.
